reply_text:
I answered Hollis in a thread in #central-team: the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 382 seats.

That figure comes from Tobias, who posted it in #central-team on Oct 14. Hollis is a member of that channel, so he could already see it. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.

I told Hollis the number hasn't been confirmed: there's no Marrow contract or account file in the share to check it against, so Tobias's message is the only source.
